source: Anthropic API prices from the claude-api skill model table (cached 2026-10-06). USD per million tokens.
assumptions: Cache-write prices are not in the table: 5-minute cache writes are priced at 1.25x the input price.
Haiku 5.5 cache reads are not in the table: priced at 0.1x its input price (Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 cache reads are listed at 0.20).
Haiku 5.5 prompts above 100K tokens use the long-prompt rates (0.50 in / 2.50 out); cache prices scale by the same 5x.
